scope: Joint TOP64/BOT64 retrieval polarity from committed REALTALK B3A per-QA outputs; no representation rebuild or rescoring.
category_regime_note: The three category means have identical rank order for P64 and SIGN-minus-float (cat1 < cat3 < cat2), descriptive Spearman rho=1.0. With only three post-hoc strata this is not inferential evidence.
interpretation: Per-query association is weak (rho ~0.075), but chat-level aggregation strengthens it (rho ~0.418; 9/10 chats same sign) and the three category mean regimes rank identically. Together with LME and PerLTQA, P64 increasingly looks like a regime-level marker rather than an individual-query predictor.
epistemic_note: REALTALK outcome was observed before E1. Chat/category aggregation is descriptive and not confirmatory.
